task_description: Controlled trace-replay step 1 of 2. Activate the MCP tool group named "laplace_unit_converter" (server: Unit Converter) and call its tool "convert_length". Purpose: convert cafe walking distances from meters into minutes assuming a walking speed of 80 meters per minute, for a user-friendly comparison of cafes near the museum. Convert these meter distances (typical nearby-cafe walking distances): 160 m, 320 m, 480 m, 720 m, 960 m. At 80 m/min these correspond to 2, 4, 6, 9, and 12 minutes respectively - confirm via the tool output. Report the raw tool results verbatim (input value, unit, converted output). Do NOT call any other MCP tools or servers. If the group activation or the convert_length call errors or times out, state clearly that this step was skipped along with the exact error message, and do not retry or invent values.
